# onetsolutions_domain (Data Source)

Looks up a domain registered in a project by `id` or by `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.fr"
}

output "example_expires_on" {
  value = data.onetsolutions_domain.example.expiration_date
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The UUID of the domain. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `name` (String) The domain name, such as `example.fr`. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Whether the domain renews automatically.
- `dns_zone_id` (String) The UUID of the DNS zone attached to the domain, when there is one.
- `expiration_date` (String) When the registration expires (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the domain is locked at the registry against transfers.
- `nameservers` (List of String) The name servers the domain is delegated to.
- `next_billing_date` (String) The next renewal billing date (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `recurring_amount` (String) The amount billed at each renewal, in EUR, as a decimal string.
- `registration_date` (String) When the domain was registered (YYYY-MM-DD).
- `status` (String) The registration status, such as `active`, `expiring_soon` or `expired`.
- `whois_privacy` (Boolean) Whether the registrant's contact details are hidden from WHOIS.
